messages:
pagerduty: 🔔 PagerDuty incident INC-17533 triggered for service=svc-inference-gateway (us-west1) — 5m error rate above threshold (8%). https://pagerduty.example/INC-17533

alex: @pagerduty acked and taking. I'm oncall. :hand: starting triage, will post TL;DR.

maya: looking at console now — spike correlates with a flurry of 502/504 from sidecar auth path. High TLS handshake failures in the sidecar logs.

sam: logs (snippet):
```
sidecar-auth@us-west1 ERROR: TLS handshake failed: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
sidecar-auth@us-west1 ERROR: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate
```

alex: hmm — cert-rotator cronjob runs every 6h. Can someone check the cert-rotator pod status in us-west1?

maya: cert-rotator shows CrashLoopBackOff, image pull error: "ErrImagePull: unauthorized" — looks like image pull secret rotation failed during deploy earlier. kubectl describe: `Back-off pulling image "registry.internal/redwood/cert-rotator:latest"`

sam: that would explain expired certs on sidecars. I'm going to temporarily shift traffic away from us-west1 to eu-west1 while we fix cert-rotator. Executing routing change now.

deploy-bot: route-change: `rctl route set inference us-west1=10 eu-west1=90` — applied by sam.

leah: initiating scaled restart of cert-rotator in us-west1 with fallback image tag `cert-rotator:v2026-03-16` to avoid registry auth. `kubectl set image ...` rolling restart in progress.

alex: monitoring metrics — 1m error rate in us-west1 jumped to 8.1% at 1753334400, after route change it's trending down. Current 5m error rate (global): 2.3%.

maya: running quick mitigation: redeploy sidecar with new cert bundle where possible, and restart a subset of frontends to pick up new certs. I'll coordinate with deploy.

sam: patched image pull secret on the cert-rotator service account (registry token expired). Redeploying cert-rotator pod now.

maria: (typo — not participant)

alex: good sign — cert-rotator pod is healthy (READY 1/1) and issued new certs. Sidecar TLS errors dropping in logs.

sam: metrics update: us-west1 5m error rate 0.9% -> global 5m 1.0% after reroute + cert fix. Latency normal.

leah: customer impact note: some customers in us-west1 observed transient 502s between 23:12–23:18 PST, highest retry volume from account ACME_CORP. Outreach started via CSM @marty. No widespread data loss observed.

alex: going to leave a detailed incident note in PagerDuty and mark as "partial mitigation". We'll keep a watch for 30m. Next steps: (1) rotate registry token tied to cert-rotator auth, (2) add alert for cert-rotator CrashLoopBackOff, (3) validate cert expiry checks in monitoring.

charles: I can take the watch for the night shift — will monitor dashboards and ensure PD doesn't re-fire. Taking over at 23:40 PST.

alex: thanks @charles — handing off. My local notes: reroute applied, cert-rotator fixed, sidecars back to healthy; PD incident INC-17533 annotated. Leaving runbook snippet:
```
- If sidecar TLS handshake failures spike:
  1) check cert-rotator pod status: `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=cert-rotator`
  2) if CrashLoopBackOff -> inspect image pull secret and registry token `kubectl get secret reg-token -o yaml`
  3) apply temporary route change: `rctl route set inference us-west1=0 eu-west1=100`
  4) restart sidecars in small batches
```

charles: acknowledged, I'll post updates if anything resurfaces. tagging on-call SRE rotation too. :eyes:

pagerduty: Incident INC-17533 acknowledged by alex and assigned to charles (on-call).

alex: leaving thread. Good job team — closing Slack thread, will follow up in the PD incident with timeline + RCA notes. :white_check_mark:
